description: Pull recent orders from one linked store, for the store sales view. since limits it to orders after that time; the default is since the last sync, or 60 days on the first. Platforms that cannot read orders answer an error. Needs a Last Price credential with commerce configure scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

connector_id.description: The connector id, as list_commerce_connectors gives it.

name: sync_commerce_orders
